========================================
StarAxis Space Strategy Game - Distribution
========================================

[START GAME]
1. Double-click "StarAxis.bat" to start the game server
2. Wait for console to show "Server started" message
3. Open browser and visit http://localhost:17890

[FILE DESCRIPTION]
- StarAxis.jar        : Main game executable
- StarAxis.bat        : Game launcher (uses bundled JDK)
- StarAxis-Debug.bat  : Debug launcher (shows verbose logs)
- README.txt          : This file
- openjdk-21.0.2/     : Bundled JDK (DO NOT DELETE)
- webui/              : Frontend web files
- saves/              : Save games directory (auto-created)

[SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS]
- Windows 10/11 64-bit
- RAM: 4GB+ (8GB recommended)
- No Java installation required (bundled openjdk-21.0.2 included)

[NOTES]
1. DO NOT delete or move openjdk-21.0.2 folder, or game won't start
2. Game uses port 17890, ensure it's not occupied by other apps
3. Save files are stored in saves/ directory

[TROUBLESHOOTING]
If game won't start:
1. Check if openjdk-21.0.2 folder exists
2. Run StarAxis-Debug.bat to see detailed error messages
3. Check if port 17890 is occupied by another program
